root_cause.text: The `skb_gro_receive()` function in the network GRO subsystem merges skbs containing zerocopy fragments without verifying the `SKBFL_MANAGED_FRAG_REFS` flag, leading to improper page reference management and use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that when `SKBFL_MANAGED_FRAG_REFS` is set, the skb does not hold page references, and appending these frags without fixing refcounts causes UAF; the patch resolves this by adding `if (skb_zcopy(p) || skb_zcopy(skb)) return -ETOOMANYREFS;` to prevent merging zerocopy skbs.
